OD-01: Customer, order and inventory data source
nodes.rationale: Applied default: Option A — a SourceAdapter protocol (Phase 3 task 3.1); everything above reads normalised rows and the adapter is the only place that knows the source shape. Stub adapter ships with seeded fixtures so the whole of M1 is buildable and testable without the real source.

nodes.label: OD-02: Qualifying-order rules, Returning vs Repeat (qualifying = paid or completed, net of refunds; Returning = ≥1; Repeat = ≥2)
nodes.rationale: Chosen B — paid or completed, net of refunds — the only rule where total_spend reconciles with the business's bank statement; rule versioned in customer_orders.qualifying_rule_version.

nodes.label: OD-03: Tenant model — multi-tenant SaaS on shared schema, business_id + PostgreSQL RLS
nodes.rationale: Two layers: ORM hook appending business_id = :bid plus RLS policies with FORCE, so raw SQL or a psql session can't bypass. App connects as xenovarients_app (NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS); migrations run as a separate owner role.

nodes.label: OD-04: Bubble persistence and dismissal rules (bubbles in dashboard only, persisted indefinitely; dismissed → new on new inbound message)
OD-05: Channel eligibility per provider (Email and SMS default; Messenger and WhatsApp opt-in per business, evaluated at send time)
nodes.rationale: Eligibility rules live in configs/channel_eligibility.json, not code, so changing them is a config edit; evaluated at send time, not preview, so late changes can't silently block sends.

nodes.label: OD-06: Meta ad data access tier (Tier 3 — manual intake — ships as the baseline)
nodes.rationale: Built against an AdSource interface with source_tier so tiers 1/2 are additive later. MI-03: metrics from different tiers are never mixed into one ranking.

nodes.label: OD-07: Consent capture, retention and erasure (per customer/channel/purpose; erasure deletes PII, keeps consent record hashed)
nodes.rationale: Retention: reviews and review replies 24 months, chats 24 months, consent records indefinitely, audit log 24 months. legal_hold suspends erasure.

nodes.label: OD-08: Review defaults (3-day delay, 09:00–20:00 send window, 14-day reply window, 1 request per order; business timezone)
OD-09: FAQ ownership, editing and review workflow (owner/admin author and edit; owner_user_id + review_due_at; overdue flagged and excluded from highest-trust matcher tier)
nodes.rationale: Aliases are separate faq_aliases rows so Banglish/Bangla spellings resolve to one entry without duplicating the entry.

nodes.label: OD-10: AI provider, cost caps, retention and redaction (provider deferred to Phase 5 via LLMPort; caps enforced pre-call; PII redacted before provider call)
nodes.rationale: Per-request and per business/day caps enforced before the call, refusal visible in the dashboard; redaction uses stable placeholders before the provider call and re-hydrates before display; chat retention 24 months.

nodes.label: OD-11: Technology stack and hosting (FastAPI, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, SQLAlchemy async, Alembic, Pydantic v2, Next.js, SSE realtime)
OD-12: Stock-warning thresholds and inventory authority (warn when stock_after < eligible waiting-list count; warning in batch preview)
nodes.rationale: The inventory source is authoritative — the app mirrors what the source says; warning appears in the batch preview so the owner sees it while they can still decide.

nodes.label: OD-13: UI language (English + Bangla, English default, switcher in app shell; business default locale)
nodes.rationale: English-first UI with Bangla content available rather than a fully translated UI; customer-facing text is what needs Bangla.
